title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 14: the cleansing of a healed leper with birds and offerings, and the law of mildew in a house.

questions.text: Where does the priest go to examine a leper on the day of his cleansing?
questions.explanation: The leper is brought to the priest, and the priest goes out of the camp to examine him.

answers.text: Out of the camp
Into the Most Holy Place
To the leper's own tent
Into the nearest city

questions.text: What is taken along with two living clean birds for the leper's cleansing?
questions.explanation: The priest commands them to take two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet and hyssop.

answers.text: Olive wood, purple and myrrh
Acacia wood, linen and salt
Cedar wood, scarlet and hyssop
Gold, silver and incense

questions.text: What does the priest do with the living bird?
questions.explanation: After sprinkling the one being cleansed seven times, the priest lets the living bird go into the open field.

answers.text: Offers it as a burnt offering
Gives it to the cleansed man
Keeps it at the Tent of Meeting
Lets it go into the open field

questions.text: After coming back into the camp, where must the cleansed man stay for seven days?
questions.explanation: After washing, shaving and bathing he comes into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

answers.text: Inside the Tent of Meeting
Outside his tent
In the house of the priest
Outside the city gate

questions.text: What must he shave off on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day he shall shave all his hair off his head, his beard and his eyebrows.

answers.text: Only the hair on the top of his head
Only his beard, leaving his head alone
Nothing, since he already shaved before
All his hair, including his beard and eyebrows

questions.text: Where does the priest put blood of the trespass offering on the man being cleansed?
questions.explanation: The priest puts it on the tip of his right ear, the thumb of his right hand and the big toe of his right foot.

answers.text: On his forehead and on both of his hands
On his right ear, right thumb and right big toe
On his left ear, left hand and left foot
On his clothes and on the hair of his head

questions.text: Into what does the priest pour some of the log of oil?
questions.explanation: The priest pours some of the log of oil into the palm of his own left hand.

answers.text: A golden bowl from the altar
The cupped hands of the man
The palm of his own left hand
The bronze basin of water

questions.text: If the leper is poor, what may he bring for the sin offering and the burnt offering?
questions.explanation: If he is poor, he shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

answers.text: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
Two male goats from the flock
Two young bulls from the herd
Two rams without any defect

questions.text: What must happen before the priest goes in to examine a house with a plague?
questions.explanation: The priest commands that they empty the house, so that all that is in it is not made unclean.

answers.text: The house must be washed with water
The family must offer a lamb
The roof must be removed
The house must be emptied

questions.text: What happens if the plague breaks out again after the house has been scraped and plastered?
questions.explanation: If the plague has spread, it is a destructive mildew; he shall break down the house and carry it out of the city to an unclean place.

answers.text: The house is plastered a third time
The owner must leave the land
The house is broken down
The house is given to the priests
